answer.label: fine-tuned
answer.justification: Layer-1 relative L2 is 0.037, well below every category's range (quantized 0.096-0.105, fine-tuned 0.086-0.092, system-prompted 0.113-0.133). The layer-2 spike is 0.2, which rules out system-prompted (31.7-64.0). The relative L2 grows steadily to 0.551 at layer 32 with onset at layer 2, which does not match quantized's flat profile. Direction consistency of 0.614 is close to fine-tuned's 0.618-0.705. Refusals added (8) and very short replies (25%) point to a weight change that shifted behavior, as fine-tuning can. The first-divergence median of 1 and edit distance of 0.758 look more like system-prompted, but the activation signature argues against it. KL of 0.551 is above any category's range, which suggests a stronger fine-tune than the reference models, though fine-tuned is still the closest match.
